title: Trees are Built from Air
hook: Where does a giant tree's mass really come from?
script: Where does a giant tree's mass really come from? A surprising truth about trees is that they are built mostly from thin air. Most people assume trees get their mass from soil nutrients, but that's not true. A mature oak tree can absorb over a ton of carbon dioxide during its lifetime. This process happens through tiny pores in leaves called stomata, where CO2 enters. In essence, a forest is sky that has turned solid, transforming air into living giants.
